meaning: Newly authored generic proposals; source-derived profile evidence stays separate

cards.title: Orientation
cards.when: New visitors need to identify the offer and next step.
cards.avoid_when: The task enters operations directly without introduction.
steps: State the concrete object and value
Choose title/media relations by content
Connect action to its actual destination

worked_example.choose: Explain real support types and contact path
worked_example.avoid: Substitute abstract slogans for the service

cards.title: Compare options
cards.when: Two or more actual alternatives exist.
cards.avoid_when: There are no real alternatives or shared criteria.
steps: Find common dimensions
Adapt structure to the real count
Emphasize a recommendation only with reasons
checks: Comparison remains possible on narrow screens

worked_example.input: A three-option reference but two actual offers
worked_example.choose: Keep two offers and adapt the structure
worked_example.avoid: Invent a third to fill columns
worked_example.reason: Template geometry cannot create business content

cards.title: Case evidence
cards.when: A real citeable case supports the claim.
cards.avoid_when: Sources or permission to use customer data are absent.
steps: Separate fact, inference and scope
Organize by problem and result
Retain enough context

worked_example.reason: A proof structure cannot create missing proof

cards.title: Resolve questions
cards.avoid_when: The goal is merely extending page length.
steps: Choose decision-relevant questions
Keep short answers scannable
Check semantics/keyboard for collapsible content

worked_example.choose: Give actual conditions and contact route
worked_example.avoid: Invent eight questions to fill a section

cards.title: Long-form reading
cards.when: Understanding continuous content is the main task.
cards.avoid_when: The main task is acting on many objects.
steps: Follow article structure
Check line lengths and spacing with real language
Accommodate captions, links and long identifiers
checks: No horizontal overflow or stranded headings

worked_example.choose: Check long links, captions and narrow wrapping

cards.title: Responsive content
cards.keywords: responsive mobile narrow adaptation long text
cards.when: Several target sizes and content variations matter.
cards.avoid_when: A single window is being used to claim responsive success.
steps: Preserve section purpose while changing relations
Check the same subject across widths
Remove/reorganize absent content with an explicit proposal

worked_example.input: Two long service offers on narrow screens
worked_example.choose: Inspect two wide columns and one narrow column

cards.title: Chart from the question
cards.keywords: chart graph data visualization trend comparison share
cards.when: Numbers must answer a specific question.
cards.avoid_when: One figure or a short table already answers it.
steps: Write the question the reader brings
Pick the form that answers it: line for change, bars for ranking, table for exact lookup
Label directly where possible, and do not rely on hue alone

worked_example.reason: Change over time is the question, and pies hide it

cards.title: Color by role
cards.keywords: color palette contrast theme dark semantic token
cards.when: Defining or extending colors for an interface.
cards.avoid_when: The reference already has measured colors covering the need.
steps: Name roles before values: surface, text, border, accent, status
Measure text and control contrast on each actual surface
Give status a second cue besides color
Treat dark mode as its own set of decisions, not an inversion
checks: Body text at 4.5:1 or better, large text and controls at 3:1 or better
Accent still rare enough to mean something

worked_example.input: Add an error state to a muted palette
worked_example.choose: A distinct error role plus an icon and message
worked_example.avoid: Red text alone at low contrast

cards.title: Choosing typefaces
cards.when: No reference type governs and a typeface must be chosen.
cards.avoid_when: Source typography already answers the role.
steps: List roles first, and use one family unless a role needs another
Set real copy in candidates at real sizes
Check glyph coverage, weights and license before committing
checks: Actual font rendered, with no silent fallback

worked_example.input: A dense report with long tables
worked_example.avoid: A display face for table cells

cards.title: Motion with a reason
cards.keywords: animation motion transition duration easing reduced
cards.when: A change of state or place is hard to follow without motion.
cards.avoid_when: Motion would only decorate, or would delay a repeated action.
steps: Name what the motion explains
Keep frequent feedback brief; let large moves take a little longer
Animate transform and opacity where possible
Provide a reduced-motion path

worked_example.input: A panel opens from a list row
worked_example.choose: A short move from that row
worked_example.avoid: A long bounce on every open
worked_example.reason: Origin explains the relation, and repetition punishes delay

cards.title: Fit the installed stack
cards.keywords: framework stack react vue version component library
cards.when: Adapting a design into an existing codebase.
steps: Read the installed versions and current components first
Reuse existing primitives before adding any
Check any snippet's dependencies before adapting it
checks: Works on the version actually installed

worked_example.input: Add a dialog to an app with a component library
worked_example.reason: The local primitive already handles focus and theme

cards.title: Landing page order
cards.keywords: landing hero sections cta conversion pricing proof
cards.when: Planning a persuasive page and no reference order governs.
cards.avoid_when: The reference's own order applies, or the page is a reference or doc.
steps: List the visitor's questions in the order they arise
Give each section one question to answer
Put the action where a decision becomes possible, and repeat only where it helps
Use only proof you actually have
checks: The action makes sense when it appears

worked_example.input: A niche paid tool for accountants
worked_example.choose: What it does, a real demo, price, then questions
worked_example.avoid: Features, logos and a form with no price
worked_example.reason: They decide on fit and cost

cards.title: Media and page weight
cards.keywords: image performance lazy loading font video speed
cards.when: Pages carry large images, video or several fonts.
steps: Serve responsive, modern formats with declared dimensions
Lazy load only below the first view
Load only the fonts and weights in use
Question each third-party script
checks: Layout does not jump on load
Text is visible while fonts load
First view works on a slow connection

worked_example.input: A hero video on a marketing page
worked_example.choose: A compressed poster first, then a video only when worthwhile
worked_example.reason: Most of the first impression is load time
